coverage: Physical village gate -> courtyard front door -> hall living-room door -> living room -> matching hall door -> courtyard -> village. Ten household points, two household task cancel/finish/replay lifecycles and all three living-room decoration preview/cancel/place/remove/undo paths.
fixture: Isolated fresh save with the three existing decorations already owned. Ownership is a test fixture, not a purchase or reward. No coins are added or spent.

refined_foliage.scope: Actual imported courtyard mesh batches, common runtime trunk pivots and the real LivingWorld.tick function; no source vertices or collision geometry are changed.

scope_limit: Focused regression for the two refined sample scenes; does not run other household rooms or the complete world suite. Headless results do not claim visual quality or GPU performance.
